item.title: Forecast: Front brings widespread showers across mid-Missouri tonight with cooler air for the week ahead
item.description: A front will move through mid-Missouri bringing showers overnight and cooler conditions for the week ahead.

item.title: Port of Seattle, Alaska Airlines review ICE incident during boarding of Seattle-LA flight
item.description: The Port of Seattle and Alaska Airlines are reviewing an immigration enforcement incident involving two passengers as they boarded an Alaska Airlines flight from Seattle to Los Angeles Saturday morning.
